moment: It turns its hand away from you and spreads its fingers over Faelspire. In every street visible through the broken ceiling, cats stop at once and look toward something only they can hear. The fragment has failed to make you look away twice. So it begins asking the city.
style: Engraved etching illustration, dense crosshatching, fine ink linework, monochrome, no colour. Heavy blacks, high contrast, deep shadow, dark inked plate. The characters are anthropomorphic cats.
